The **Confirm dialog** is a Material dialog using `{colors.parent-raised}`, 28 dp corners, `{typography.parent-title}`, and `{typography.parent-body}`. It presents equally styled “Keep” / “Delete” actions, with Keep first; Delete names exactly what is removed and uses no danger color (NFR-18). Deletions require PIN first, “within 30 days” is marked `[ASSUMPTION: CQ-17]`, and “Delete everything” explicitly says model files stay.
